title: Engineer III
description:
Engineer III
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Model: Hybrid
Location: Dallas, Texas
Client is seeking an experienced Engineer III to support engineering and project management activities related to midstream pipeline and hydrocarbon infrastructure operations. This role will support design, construction, optimization, and operational improvement projects involving transmission and gathering systems, compressor and pump stations, storage facilities, and measurement systems.
The ideal candidate will possess strong oil & gas industry experience, preferably within midstream operations, along with technical expertise in pipeline systems, facility operations, project management, and engineering analysis.
This role requires the ability to manage multiple engineering assignments, coordinate construction and operational projects, support process safety initiatives, and provide technical guidance related to pipeline and hydrocarbon processing facilities.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering & Technical Support
  • Perform engineering activities related to:
    • Transmission and gathering systems
    • Compressor and pump stations
    • Measurement and regulation facilities
    • Hydrocarbon storage facilities
    • Dehydration plants
  • Support equipment/system design and optimization initiatives
  • Conduct pipeline sizing, valve sizing, hydraulic calculations, and liquid flow analysis
  • Assist with pipeline facility design, construction, operation, and maintenance activities
  • Evaluate pipeline and measurement system performance and recommend improvements
Project Management & Construction Support
  • Support engineering project management activities including:
    • Bid proposals and contracts
    • AFE preparation and cost management
    • Material and equipment selection
    • Construction planning and implementation
    • Schedule and timeline management
    • Change order management
  • Coordinate third-party contract resources
  • Support Management of Change (MOC) activities
  • Prepare engineering reports, project updates, and technical documentation
Operations & Process Improvement
  • Analyze operational issues and recommend improvements related to:
    • Capacity optimization
    • System operations
    • Operating costs
    • Equipment efficiencies
  • Conduct load studies and economic analyses for new projects
  • Support process safety and operational compliance initiatives
  • Research and interpret governmental regulations, industry codes, and engineering standards
Communication & Collaboration
  • Collaborate with engineering, operations, and construction teams
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively across multiple departments
  • Assist with implementation of operational and engineering process improvements
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Bachelor's Degree in:
    • Chemical Engineering
    • Mechanical Engineering
    • Petroleum Engineering
  • Minimum 3+ years of engineering experience
  • Oil & Gas industry experience required
  • Midstream industry experience preferred
  • Experience with:
    • Pipeline systems
    • Hydrocarbon processing facilities
    • Engineering design
    • Operations support
    • Project management
  • Experience with Microsoft Office applications including:
    • Excel
    • Word
    • Project
    • Access
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
Preferred Qualifications
  • Midstream pipeline operations experience
  • Experience with:
    • Gathering systems
    • Liquids measurement
    • Pipeline regulation facilities
    • Storage operations
    • Pipeline stress/strain analysis
  • Experience supporting construction and field operations
  • Knowledge of process safety and industry compliance standards
  • Experience preparing engineering studies, budgets, and contracts
  • Experience supporting economic analysis for capital projects

  • Oil & Gas Operations
  • Pipeline Engineering
  • Project Management

title: Business Analyst
description:
Role: Business Analyst
Location: Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada
Job Type: Contract
Work Model: 100% Onsite
Duration: Multi-Year Engagement (Year 1 / Year 2 / Year 3)
Client is seeking experienced Business Analyst consultants to support major public-sector digital transformation and modernization initiatives. The selected consultants will work within formal governance and accountability structures supporting government ministries, agencies, and regulated environments.
This engagement focuses on business transformation, SaaS/cloud modernization, process improvement, stakeholder management, testing coordination, organizational readiness, and training delivery for enterprise IT and digital initiatives.
The Business Analyst will collaborate with stakeholders, project managers, SMEs, vendors, and technical teams to gather requirements, facilitate workshops, define business processes, support testing activities, and prepare detailed business analysis documentation.
The ideal candidate will possess strong communication, stakeholder engagement, workshop facilitation, testing coordination, and process transformation experience within regulated or public-sector environments.
Key Responsibilities
Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
  • Gather, analyze, validate, and document business requirements
  • Define business problems, opportunities, and solution recommendations
  • Conduct feasibility studies and business case analysis
  • Translate business requirements into business rules and technical requirements
  • Develop use cases, user stories, and workflow documentation
Process Analysis & Transformation
  • Create As-Is and To-Be workflows and process maps
  • Support business process transformation initiatives
  • Conduct process discovery and backlog refinement workshops
  • Identify operational efficiencies and modernization opportunities
Stakeholder Management & Collaboration
  • Facilitate workshops, meetings, and stakeholder sessions
  • Collaborate with:
    • Project Managers
    • SMEs
    • Technical Teams
    • Vendors
    • Deployment Teams
    • Business Leaders
  • Present business and technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
Testing & Quality Assurance
  • Support testing strategy and test planning activities
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
  • Develop test scenarios and test scripts
  • Support QA validation and requirements verification
Organizational Readiness & Training
  • Support change management and organizational readiness initiatives
  • Develop training materials and facilitate end-user training
  • Support business adoption activities for IT modernization projects
Documentation & Reporting
  • Prepare:
    • Business Cases
    • Feasibility Studies
    • Technical Assessments
    • Project Charters
    • RFP/RFI Requirements
    • User Manuals
    • Policies & Procedures
  • Maintain project and BA documentation standards
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Mandatory CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) Certification
  • CBAP certificate copy required during submission
  • Strong experience as a practicing Business Analyst
  • Experience supporting public-sector or regulated-environment transformation initiatives
  • Experience working within formal governance and policy structures
  • Strong experience with:
    • Requirements gathering
    • Business process analysis
    • UAT coordination
    • Workshop facilitation
    • Stakeholder management
    • Testing support
    • Organizational readiness
  • Experience with cloud/SaaS modernization projects
  • Ability to work onsite in Regina, Saskatchewan from contract start
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
Preferred Qualifications
  • Saskatchewan Government or Crown corporation experience
  • Experience supporting government digital transformation initiatives
  • Experience with:
    • APIs
    • System integrations
    • Data flows
    • Security concepts
    • Azure DevOps
    • Microsoft Power BI
  • Experience facilitating business process discovery workshops
  • Strong change management and training delivery experience
  • Experience working with vendors and multi-stakeholder government environments
Core Skills
  • Business Analysis
  • CBAP
  • Public Sector Transformation
  • Requirements Gathering
  • Process Mapping
  • Workshop Facilitation
  • UAT Coordination
  • Business Rules Documentation
  • Stakeholder Management
  • SaaS / Cloud Modernization
  • Organizational Readiness

title: Registered Nurse
description:
Job Title: Registered Nurse
Location: Aztec, New Mexico
Job Type: Contract
Work Model: 100% Onsite
Contract Duration: July 27, 2026 – May 28, 2027
Renewal Option: Up to 3 Additional Annual Renewals
Schedule: 37.5 Hours/Week | 7.5 Hours/Day | School Calendar Schedule
Coverage Area: 2 High Schools, 1 Middle School, 3 Elementary Schools
Client is seeking qualified Registered Nurses to provide comprehensive school nursing services supporting both general education and special-needs students across the district. The district serves multiple school campuses and requires strong clinical nursing support, emergency response capabilities, student wellness management, and compliance with school healthcare regulations.
The RN will support student wellness initiatives, medication administration, emergency response planning, health documentation, Medicaid compliance, and school health programs while maintaining compliance with FERPA, HIPAA, New Mexico PED, and Department of Health requirements.
The ideal candidate will possess strong pediatric/school nursing experience, excellent communication skills, emergency response capabilities, and the ability to work collaboratively within a school district environment.
Key Responsibilities
Clinical Nursing Services
  • Perform student health screenings and nursing assessments
  • Provide referrals and follow-up care based on assessment findings
  • Support students with IHPs, IEPs, and 504 plans
  • Participate in student registration health record review
  • Support home visit participation if required
  • Supervise and delegate appropriate duties to health assistants and unlicensed personnel
Medication Administration & Emergency Response
  • Administer medications and nursing procedures
  • Maintain medication administration documentation
  • Monitor AED equipment and emergency preparedness readiness
  • Respond to student and staff medical emergencies
  • Coordinate emergency transportation when required
  • Maintain health room coverage during school hours
Student Wellness & Health Education
  • Provide instruction and guidance regarding:
    • Hygiene
    • Communicable disease prevention
    • Puberty education
    • Student wellness initiatives
  • Participate in district wellness programs and health functions
Documentation & Compliance
  • Maintain:
    • Health records
    • Immunization records
    • Medication logs
    • Medicaid documentation
    • SNAP system records
  • Ensure FERPA and HIPAA compliance
  • Complete Medicaid-related documentation and reporting
  • Maintain active NPI number and Medicaid participation requirements
Regulatory & Administrative Responsibilities
  • Comply with:
    • New Mexico PED guidelines
    • NM Department of Health standards
    • Board of Education policies
    • Federal and state healthcare regulations
  • Participate in district policy implementation and health program administration
  • Complete AMSD-required online training and onboarding activities
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) License – State of New Mexico
  • PED (Public Education Department) Licensure/Credential
    • Pending licensure may be accepted
  • Background verification and fingerprint clearance
  • Strong computer and documentation skills
  • Ability to comply with:
    • Medicaid requirements
    • FERPA regulations
    • HIPAA requirements
  • Experience working with pediatric or school-aged populations
  • Strong communication and emergency response skills
  • Ability to work onsite within district schools
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior school nursing experience
  • Experience supporting special education students
  • Experience with IHP / IEP / 504 student support
  • Experience with Medicaid documentation and billing
  • Pediatric nursing background
  • Experience with communicable disease management
  • Experience providing health education and wellness programs
  • Familiarity with New Mexico PED school health guidelines
Core Skills
  • School Nursing
  • Pediatric Nursing
  • Student Health Services
  • Medication Administration
  • Emergency Response
  • IEP / IHP / 504 Support
  • FERPA / HIPAA Compliance
  • Medicaid Documentation
  • Immunization Management
  • Health Assessments
  • AED Monitoring
  • Student Wellness Programs
  • Nursing Documentation
  • Public Health Nursing
  • Special Education Support

title: Physical Therapy Assistant
description:
Job Title: Physical Therapy Assistant
Location: Aztec, New Mexico
Job Type: Contract
Work Model: 100% Onsite
Employment Type: Part-Time
Schedule: 30 Hours/Week | 7.5 Hours/Day × 4 Days/Week
Maximum Annual Hours: 1,110 Hours/Year
Student Service Days: 148 Student Contact Days + 5 Administrative Days
Contract Duration: 2026–2027 School Year
Renewal Option: Up to 3 Additional One-Year Renewals
Client is seeking qualified and experienced Physical Therapy Assistant (PTA) professionals to provide special education-related therapy services to students across district schools. The district serves approximately 2,050 students across elementary, middle, and high schools within the Four Corners region of New Mexico.
The district is seeking pediatric-focused therapy professionals experienced in working with students with disabilities, IEP-driven therapy services, evaluations, parent collaboration, and school-based therapy support.
The PTA will provide direct therapy services aligned with student Individualized Education Plans (IEPs), support evaluations and assessments, participate in IEP meetings, collaborate with staff and parents, and assist with student mobility and therapy goals in compliance with state and federal educational standards.
The ideal candidate will possess strong pediatric and school-based therapy experience, excellent collaboration skills, and experience working with children with disabilities within educational settings.
Key Responsibilities
Direct Student Therapy Services
• Provide direct physical therapy services according to student IEP requirements
• Coordinate therapy schedules consistent with school calendars and student needs
• Assist students in improving mobility, physical functioning, and participation within educational settings
• Maintain therapy documentation and student progress records
Educational Evaluations & Assessments
• Participate in educational evaluations and diagnosis support
• Assist with:
o Instrument administration
o Interpretation support
o Student evaluations
• Support comprehensive written reports and therapy recommendations
IEP & Collaboration Activities
• Participate in student IEP meetings
• Collaborate with:
o Teachers
o Related service providers
o Administrators
o Parents/guardians
• Coordinate services for students identified by IEP teams or Student Assistance Teams
Consultation & Training
• Provide consultation and training support as requested by district administration
• Participate in staff coordination activities
• Support therapy-related guidance for school personnel and families
Compliance & Documentation
• Ensure therapy services comply with:
o New Mexico Public Education Department standards
o District policies
o State and federal special education regulations
• Maintain active New Mexico licensure throughout contract duration
• Provide updated license renewals as required
Materials & Equipment
• Provide own testing kits, therapy materials, and professional resources required for services
Must-Have Qualifications
• Current New Mexico PTA License
• Current New Mexico Public Education Department (PED) Licensure with endorsement
• Experience working with:
o Children
o Pediatric populations
o Students with disabilities
• Strong understanding of:
o IEP processes
o School-based therapy services
o Educational evaluations
• Strong communication and collaboration skills
• Ability to pass fingerprinting and criminal background checks prior to assignment
• Professional liability insurance required
• Ability to work onsite within district schools
Preferred Qualifications
• Prior school-based PTA experience
• Pediatric rehabilitation experience
• Experience participating in IEP meetings
• Experience conducting evaluations and therapy documentation
• Prior experience working with public school districts
• Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary educational teams
• Familiarity with New Mexico school special education compliance standards

title: Lead Cardiovascular Technologist
description:
Lead Cardiovascular Technologist
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Model: Onsite
Location: Eureka, California
Shift: 10-Hour Day Shifts
Client is seeking an experienced Lead Cardiovascular Technologist to support Cath Lab and Cardiovascular Imaging operations. Under the direction of the Department Manager/Director, the Lead Tech assumes responsibility for limited supervisory activities within the department while serving as a clinical, technical, and administrative resource for staff.
The ideal candidate will possess strong Cath Lab and interventional imaging experience, excellent technical competency, leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering exceptional patient-focused care within a collaborative healthcare environment.
Key Responsibilities
Cardiovascular & Interventional Imaging Support
  • Perform cardiovascular and interventional imaging procedures
  • Support Cath Lab procedures and imaging operations
  • Ensure accurate imaging quality and patient safety standards
  • Assist physicians and clinical teams during procedures
  • Maintain compliance with department imaging protocols and standards
Leadership & Supervisory Support
  • Serve as a clinical and technical resource for department staff
  • Support limited supervisory and operational responsibilities
  • Assist with staff coordination and workflow management
  • Promote adherence to department policies, procedures, and quality standards
  • Support training and mentoring activities within the department
Patient Care & Safety
  • Deliver patient-focused care throughout imaging and Cath Lab procedures
  • Ensure compliance with infection control and patient safety practices
  • Maintain BLS standards and emergency preparedness
  • Support accurate patient documentation and procedural records
Operational & Technical Responsibilities
  • Operate cardiovascular imaging and radiologic equipment
  • Ensure compliance with radiology and interventional imaging regulations
  • Maintain technical competency and department standards
  • Support continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives
Must-Have Qualifications
  • Graduate of a Radiology Imaging Technologist program approved by the Committee on Allied Health Education and Accreditation of the American Medical Association
  • Current California Diagnostic Radiologic Technology Certification
  • Current American Registry of Radiologic Technologists (ARRT) Certification
  • Current BLS Certification – American Heart Association
  • Minimum 2 years of experience as a hospital-based Cardiovascular and/or Interventional Imaging Technologist
  • Minimum 2 years of Cath Lab experience
  • Strong technical and clinical competency in cardiovascular imaging procedures
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Eureka, California
Preferred Qualifications
  • Cardiovascular Credentialing International (CCI) Certification
  • Prior supervisory or lead technologist experience

title: Child & Adolescent Tele Psychiatrist
description:
Position Title: Child & Adolescent Tele Psychiatrist
Job Type: Contract / Telepsychiatry
Work Model: Elmira, NY - Remote / HIPAA-Compliant Telehealth Environment
Contract Duration: 5 Years

Schedule
  • Part-Time
  • 20 Hours per Week
  • Monday–Friday
  • Primarily 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM during school year
  • No evenings/weekends required
The Child & Adolescent Telepsychiatrist will provide psychiatric evaluations, diagnosis, medication management, telepsychiatry consultations, treatment planning, and clinical documentation services for children and adolescents receiving behavioral health treatment through New York State Office of Mental Health programs.
The psychiatrist will collaborate with multidisciplinary clinical teams and utilize OMH electronic medical record systems while maintaining HIPAA-compliant telehealth practices.
Core Responsibilities
Clinical Responsibilities
  • Conduct psychiatric evaluations and assessments
  • Diagnose behavioral and mental health conditions
  • Provide medication management services
  • Develop and update treatment plans
  • Conduct telepsychiatry sessions
  • Complete admission assessments and annual evaluations
  • Prepare discharge assessments and clinical documentation
  • Maintain timely and accurate EMR documentation
  • Participate in multidisciplinary treatment team collaboration
Required Qualifications
Education
  • Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO)
Certifications
  • Board Certified in Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
    OR
  • Board Eligible within 3 years of completion of accredited fellowship program
Licensing
  • Active and unrestricted medical license
  • Ability to legally practice psychiatry in New York State
  • DEA registration preferred
Required Experience
  • Experience providing psychiatric services to children and adolescents
  • Experience with telepsychiatry/telehealth services
  • Experience using EMR/EHR systems
  • Strong clinical documentation experience
  • Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary clinical teams
Preferred Experience
  • Experience working in psychiatric hospitals or behavioral health programs
  • Experience with OMH or state behavioral health systems
  • Experience treating pediatric/adolescent psychiatric populations
  • Experience with MHARS or similar EMR systems
